name: SetupScreenElementText
evidence: slot 1 of the base element: takes the font from D_0026227C, sets scale 1, colour 0xFF808080 and an empty text

name: UpdateScreenElementSlide
evidence: slot 2 of the base element: advances the blend by the slide-in, hold or slide-out time, moves it between its hidden and shown positions, then sets the mode through slot 16

name: SetScreenElementText
evidence: slot 8 of the element tables: copies the text (or clears it), measures it with the font and sets the element's size

name: SubstituteScreenElementGlyphs
evidence: rewrites the text so characters missing from the font are taken from fonts 3 or 4 and digits after a slash are wrapped in colour codes

name: SetScreenElementScale
evidence: stores the text scale at +0x20C

name: DrawScreenElementText
evidence: slot 9 of the base element: builds a draw record from position, size and colour, draws the frame object behind it, then draws the text with the font

name: GetScreenElementSlideInTime
evidence: slot 11: returns the slide-in time at +0x240

name: GetScreenElementHoldTime
evidence: slot 12: returns the hold time at +0x244

name: GetScreenElementSlideOutTime
evidence: slot 13: returns the slide-out time at +0x248

name: SetScreenElementSlideInTime
evidence: stores the slide-in time at +0x240

name: SetScreenElementHoldTime
evidence: stores the hold time at +0x244

name: SetScreenElementSlideOutTime
evidence: stores the slide-out time at +0x248

name: ResetScreenElement
evidence: slot 5: calls slot 16 with mode 0

name: ShowScreenElement
evidence: slot 14: from mode 0 or 3 goes to mode 1 (sliding in), in mode 2 restarts the hold clock

name: HideScreenElement
evidence: slot 15: from mode 1 or 2 goes to mode 3 (sliding out)

name: SetScreenElementMode
evidence: slot 16: sets the offset into the slide for modes 1 and 3, snaps position and blend for modes 0 and 2, stores the mode and clock, and re-places anchored elements

name: AreScreenElementsTogether
evidence: slot 18: returns 1 when both are in mode 1 or 2, both in mode 3, or one in mode 3 and the other in mode 2

name: SetScreenElementSize
evidence: stores the width and height when they are not negative, then places the element

name: PlaceScreenElement
evidence: computes the shown position from the placement record (offset from the screen edge or the anchor element) on a 640 by 492.8 screen, the hidden position by the side it slides in from, and moves the element if hidden or shown

name: PlaceAnchoredScreenElements
evidence: for each of the 37 placement records anchored to the given element, places that element again

name: SetScreenElementClock
evidence: slot 17: switches the clock pointer (default D_00261868) and restarts the mode time when the clock changes

name: InitCounterCaption
evidence: slot 1 of the sixteen caption tables: sets text setup, font 2, shown -1, rate 6000 and by element index the counter it follows (game state fields or its own shown value)

name: UpdateCounterCaption
evidence: slot 2 of the caption tables: slides, counts the shown value towards its counter at the rate, runs the done callback once, rebuilds the text and resizes the element

name: DrawCounterCaption
evidence: slot 9 of the caption tables: draws the text with its alpha scaled by the screen fade

name: FormatCounterCaption
evidence: by element index formats the shown value (and limit) with a per-caption format string into the text, then substitutes glyphs

name: GetCaptionHoldTime
evidence: slot 12 of the caption tables: returns 2.5 while D_00261858 is running, else 0

name: InitTimerElement
evidence: slot 1 of the timer table D_00218510: text setup, font 2, last second and tenth -1, no warning time, f290 set, state 0

name: UpdateTimerElement
evidence: slot 2 of the timer table: slides, and when its mode is 1 or 2 hides itself after a second in state 0, else steps the timer

name: DrawTimerElement
evidence: slot 9 of the timer table: draws the frame, then the glyph T and the time text, in the warning colour once warned

name: StartTimer
evidence: clears the callbacks and warning, sets the time to the argument, rate -1 and state 1, steps once and shows the element

name: SetTimerRate
evidence: stores the rate (seconds per second) at +0x26C

name: SetTimerLimit
evidence: stores the end callback and the limit time

name: StartTimerCounting
evidence: sets the timer state to 2

name: StopTimer
evidence: sets the f290 flag and the timer state to 0

name: StepTimer
evidence: reads the time, plays the tick sounds, advances it by dt times the rate while counting, fires the warning and end callbacks, and rebuilds the minutes:seconds or tenths text

name: SetTimerState
evidence: stores the timer state and the clock time of the change when it differs

name: GetPairCaptionHoldTime
evidence: slot 12 (the hold time) of D_00217F70, the table of the caption D_0026D0C8 that ShowPairControllerElement shows: returns 0, where GetScreenElementHoldTime returns +0x244

name: GetGaugeAmountCaptionHoldTime
evidence: slot 12 (the hold time) of D_00217FC0, the table of g_gaugeAmountCaption: returns 0, where GetScreenElementHoldTime returns +0x244

name: GetGaugeColliderCaptionHoldTime
evidence: slot 12 (the hold time) of D_002181A0, the table of the caption D_0026E4E0 that UpdateGaugeColliderVisibility and HandleGaugeColliderNotification show and hide: returns 0, where GetScreenElementHoldTime returns +0x244

name: InitGauge
evidence: slot 1 of the gauge element's table D_002182E0 (whose slot 9 is DrawGauge): SetupScreenElementText, font 4, and the gauge's segment layout chosen by the save's value (g_saveData)

name: DecrementGaugeCount
evidence: counts the gauge's 0x270 down by one, rolling it over to 0x264 and decrementing 0x26C, then sets fillTarget from (rows - 1) times 0x264 plus 0x270 over 0x268 and stamps changedAt

name: DrawGauge
evidence: slot 9 of the gauge element: eases fill toward fillTarget (func_001EA4B8), draws the dark bar and the lit part with a colour interpolated by the time since changedAt (func_0019DDA0) and the letter glyph, shaking it for 0.75 seconds after a change

name: InitFramedElement
evidence: slot 1 of the plain framed element's table D_00218330: SetupScreenElementText, its font cloned at 1.25 scale and, when font 2 is loaded, the frame D_002743D0 drawn with it

name: SetCaptionTextAndSize
evidence: slot 8 of the screen-element table D_00218330: copies the string into the element's text (or clears it), measures it with MeasureText at the element's scale and sets the element's size from it

name: DrawElementWithFadedFrame
evidence: slot 9 of the plain framed element: when it has text scales the alpha of the colour and of the frame object by the blend, draws the frame, then the text with the font

name: InitPointerTextCaption
evidence: slot 1 of the pointer-text caption's table D_00218380: SetupScreenElementText, its font cloned at 0.9, the colour 0xDF7F7F7F and the frame D_002743F0 with font 2

name: SetElementTextAfterSlideOut
evidence: slot 8 of the pointer-text caption: in mode 0 sets the text at once; in modes 1 to 3 when it differs keeps the pointer in 0x264, sets the pending flag and goes to mode 3 through slot 16

name: SetElementModeApplyingPendingText
evidence: slot 16 of the pointer-text caption: when a text is pending and the mode is 0, sets the text with func_001AA4F0, clears the wait and changes to mode 1 instead

name: AreElementsTogetherOrPending
evidence: slot 18 of the pointer-text caption: returns 1 when func_001AAAC8 says so or a text is pending

name: ShowElementUnlessTextPending
evidence: slot 14 of the pointer-text caption: shows it with func_001AA8F0 unless it is in mode 3 with a new text waiting

name: HideElementOrDropPendingText
evidence: slot 15 of the pointer-text caption: in mode 3 with a new text waiting clears the wait, otherwise hides it with func_001AA958

name: DrawSlidingGlyphElement
evidence: slot 9 of the pointer-text caption: in mode 2 draws normally, in modes 1 and 3 draws the frame and each glyph in turn at a position clamped between its hidden and shown x by the blend, advancing by each glyph's width

name: InitCopiedTextCaption
evidence: slot 1 of the copied-text caption's table D_002183D0: SetupScreenElementText, font 0 cloned at 1.0, scale 0.8, a slide-out of 0.5 and the frame D_00274410 with font 2

name: SetElementTextCopiedAfterSlideOut
evidence: slot 8 of the copied-text caption: like the pointer-text version but copies the new text into the buffer at 0x264 (or empties it) and sets the pending flag

name: FormatFlagGlyphs
evidence: writes into the buffer the glyph characters for the bits 2, 4 and 8 of the record's flags that the mask selects (colour code format D_0024CD88), and for bit 8 a time as seconds fraction or minutes:seconds

name: SetElementTextFromPackedEntry
evidence: sets the text of the element through slot 8: SetElementTextFromEntry with value >> 8 and the low byte, or the string D_0024CE00 for -1

name: SetElementTextFromEntry
evidence: builds the text from the entry at index hi * 0x44C + lo * 0x78 of the table behind D_002623C0: the name from func_00160148 followed by the FormatFlagGlyphs string, then sets it through slot 8

name: SetElementTextFromIndexedCounts
evidence: builds a text from the heading D_00274430[idx] and up to three "n/m" counts of the entry from func_00160208, then sets it through slot 8

name: SetElementModeApplyingCopiedText
evidence: slot 16 of the copied-text caption: applies the pending buffer at mode 0 as func_001AC990 does and clears the announce flag when the mode becomes 0

name: ShowElementUnlessCopiedTextPending
evidence: slot 14 of the copied-text caption: returns when in mode 3 with a text pending, otherwise shows it with func_001AA8F0

name: HideElementOrDropCopiedText
evidence: slot 15 of the copied-text caption: in mode 3 with a text pending clears the wait, otherwise hides it with func_001AA958

name: DrawMessageElement
evidence: slot 9 of the copied-text caption: draws its text with alpha scaled by the blend or, while the announce flag is set, at the lowered position from D_0027240C, with a shade band under it when not announcing

name: InitHintGlyphElement
evidence: slot 1 of the screen-element table D_00218420: SetupScreenElementText, font 2 cloned at 1.0 and the text "B", with its show flag cleared

name: UpdateHintGlyphElement
evidence: slot 2 of the table D_00218420: UpdateScreenElementSlide, then shows itself (slot 14) while its flag is set, the player is not in state 6 and the element stack's top is 3 with fewer than 2 entries, else hides (slot 15)

name: DrawHintGlyphElement
evidence: slot 9 of the table D_00218420: DrawScreenElementText, then a pulsing "L" of font 1 scaled by a sine of the elapsed time

name: InitLetterboxElement
evidence: slot 1 of the screen-element table D_00218560 (whose slot 16 is SetElementModeFollowingFade): SetupScreenElementText and a slide-out of 0.5

name: SetElementModeFollowingFade
evidence: slot 16 of D_002721D0's table: while the screen fade is on in mode 1 keeps the old mode for 3 or 0, in fade mode 3 maps modes 1 and 2 to 0 or 2 and then shows the message element D_0026F138, and hides D_0026F138 and D_00273EB0 when the new mode is 0

name: DrawLetterboxElement
evidence: slot 9 of the table D_00218560: draws two black sprites across the screen, at the top and the bottom, each 66.4 times its blend high

name: InitTitleElement
evidence: slot 1 of the screen-element table D_00218470: SetupScreenElementText, its font cloned at D_00274448/D_0027444C, the frame D_00274450 with font 2 and the image record 0x493 sized 366.75 by 165.75, or else the game's title as text

name: DrawTitleElement
evidence: slot 9 of the table D_00218470: draws the image record when it has one, else DrawScreenElementText

name: InitPromptElement
evidence: slot 1 of the prompt element's table D_002184C0 (whose slot 2 is UpdatePromptElement): SetupScreenElementText, its font scaled by D_0027446C, the frame D_00274488, the two flags UpdatePromptElement recomputes, then RebuildPromptText

name: RebuildPromptText
evidence: for the prompt element: when flagA is set picks one of three strings by flagB (plus a shared line) in a grey colour, otherwise the fourth string in red, then resizes the element to the measured text

name: SetElementModeRebuildingText
evidence: slot 16 of the prompt element: when a rebuild is pending and the force argument is 0 clears the wait, runs RebuildPromptText and forces the mode change

name: UpdatePromptElement
evidence: slot 2 of the prompt element: while D_00275BF0 is 1 recomputes flagA (D_00262C84 equals 3) and flagB (D_00269988's float is nonzero), rebuilds the text with RebuildPromptText when either changed, then runs the slide update

name: DrawPromptElement
evidence: slot 9 of the prompt element's table D_002184C0: draws its text (DrawAlignedText) at its font scale, pulsing by a sine of the elapsed time

name: DrawLineSegment
evidence: draws a line between two screen points as a GS packet with the colour bytes of rgba (alpha scaled), alpha blend when alpha is below 0xFF; DrawProjectedLine ends with it

name: InitLetterGlyphElement
evidence: slot 1 of the screen-element table D_002185B0: SetupScreenElementText, font 2 and the one-letter text "L" for D_00273C50 or "K" for D_002739F0, measured at the scale D_002744A8

name: DrawLetterGlyphElement
evidence: slot 9 of the table D_002185B0: draws its one-letter glyph at its scale

name: InitCyclingGlyphElement
evidence: slot 1 of the screen-element table D_00218600: SetupScreenElementText, slide-in and slide-out of 0.25, no hold, font 1 at the scale D_002744AC and the glyph GetCyclingGlyph returns

name: SetElementModeClearingFlag
evidence: slot 16 (set mode) of the screen-element table D_00218600: clears the element's flag when the mode is 0, then runs SetScreenElementMode

name: DrawCyclingGlyphElement
evidence: draws the cycling-glyph element D_00273EB0 (file_1A7FE8's element drawing calls it last): raised while its flag holds, hiding itself a second into mode 2 once the background job has ended

name: GetCyclingGlyph
evidence: returns the character of the table behind D_002744B0 at index (clock * 5) modulo its length
